title: [LOGGED OUT] During the event, the Reward Chain shows its steps and "Log in to claim" opens the login popup

steps.saw: Store page loaded, cookie banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
Is "Reward chain" shown in the Store page header? (precondition)
steps.saw: Header shows Home, Store, Reward chain, Loyalty shop
Page moved to the Reward Chain section; Reward chain highlighted in header

steps.text: Is the "Reward Chain" heading visible on the screen?
steps.saw: Heading text Reward Chain is on screen but its top half is covered by the sticky category tab bar (only the lower part is readable); the Reward system block below it is fully visible. May be a layout bug worth review

steps.text: Does the section show "Reward system", a "Limited time" countdown, a points counter ending in "points" and a line starting with "Step 1 of"?
steps.saw: Reward system; Limited time 7h 46m; 0/1 points; Step 1 of 8

steps.text: Are reward cards shown, each with an amount and a point cost?
Click the green "Log in to claim" button.
Is the "LOG IN TO MAKE PURCHASES" popup with a QR code shown?
steps.saw: Popup LOG IN TO MAKE PURCHASES with text Scan the QR code with your mobile device and a QR code

steps.text: Click the red close (x) button of the popup.

steps.saw: Popup closed, Reward Chain section visible again
